character.y: 早年在平定山越的战争中立有大功，又讨平叛乱无数，身经百战，所向披靡，深受孙权器重。后来在与魏国的多次边境争斗中也屡立战功，官至后将军，并领徐州牧。
character.z: 装备牌越多则技能越多，可以用闪来获取敌人的牌。
character.x: 用最精良的兵器，####打最漂亮的胜仗！

skills.o: 锁定技，若你装备区里牌的花色数大于等于以下值，你视为拥有：1.“<font href='979'>短兵</font>”；2.“<font href='712'>英姿</font>”；3.“<font href='708'>奋威</font>”；4.“<font href='3072'>澜疆</font>”。
出牌阶段限一次，你可以展示你与一名攻击范围内不包含你的角色共计至多X张手牌（X为你的空装备栏数），然后弃置其中的【闪】，若如此做，你获得其一张未以此法展示的牌。

primaryRow.o: 你使用【杀】可以多指定一名距离为1的角色为目标。你对距离为1的角色使用【杀】需两张【闪】才能抵消。
primaryRow.v: 请选择一名角色作为<font color='#FFD800'>杀</font>的额外目标
primaryRow.ay: 系统提示→择一名角色→点"确定"

primaryRow.o: 锁定技，摸牌阶段，你多摸一张牌。你的手牌上限为你的体力上限。
primaryRow.bb: 锁定技，摸牌阶段，你多摸一张牌。你的手牌上限为你的血上限（而非血量）。

primaryRow.o: 限定技，当一张锦囊牌指定多个目标后，你可以令此牌对任意个目标无效。
primaryRow.bb: 限定技，当一张锦囊牌指定多个目标后，你可以令此牌对任意个目标无效。
primaryRow.v: 请选择至少一名角色，使该锦囊对这些角色无效
primaryRow.ay: 系统提示→点"奋威"→选择角色→点"确定"

primaryRow.o: 结束阶段，你可以令所有手牌数大于等于你的角色依次选择是否令你摸一张牌。选择完成后，你可以对手牌数等于你的其中一名角色造成1点伤害，然后令手牌数小于你的其中一名角色摸一张牌。

implementationInterpretations: ShanXi uses reverse target attack range: target attack range must not contain owner.
X is sum of available equipment-slot capacities minus actual occupied slots; abolished/unavailable slots do not count.
The owner chooses one common subset of both actual hands up to X. Foreign hand choices show opaque frozen slots without IDs or faces; public reveal happens only on confirmation.

After public reveal, only real current Dodge entities that can be legally discarded are moved. Owner voluntary discard respects XiaHui; foreign forced discard does not copy recipient self-discard prohibitions.
Only a genuine Dodge discard permits one gain. Subsequent choice can select unrevealed target HEJ, using hidden slots for Hand and public entities for Equipment/Judgment.

QiZhou counts current effective equipment suits (None excluded). A pure source-independent raw-grant path evaluates registered Always RewriteSuit policies in the native SkillId/instance order, without entering the recursively qualified binding shard. Active context-dependent rewrites are explicitly unsupported and rejected rather than silently falling back to printed suit.

All four thresholds are cumulative. Each source relation retains its stable effective skill instance through threshold exit/reentry, preserving FenWei once-game ledger. Source loss revokes derived grants.

An equipment source receipt proves original ownership but alone cannot authorize a new activation. Only exact paid native FrozenHandRoster movement/damage invoice receives continuation privilege; unissued later benefits stop under existing source-loss rules.
